# logs commands

Every `logs` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `logs:app`

Read application log files with filtering (optimised for LLM agents)

```bash
bin/semitexa logs:app
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--file` | yes |
| `--lines` | yes |
| `--grep` | yes |
| `--level` | yes |
| `--since` | yes |
| `--around` | yes |
| `--context` | yes |
| `--json` | no |
| `--list` | no |
